title: Brycen's Modern UI
description: An attempt to make Java Edition UI feel more modern. Inspired mainly by Minecraft Bedrock's menus.
body:
# A Resource Pack by BrycenPro15
[Check out all of my other creations on Modrinth!](https://modrinth.com/user/BrycenPro15)

### Overview
**Brycen's Modern UI** is an attempt to make Java Edition UI feel more modern.

**Totally revamps Minecraft's UI** because the current vanilla one has been around for over 15 years. Haven't you gotten tired of that old look?

**It won't be supported for newer (1.20.2+) versions yet** because I prefer using the large "sheet" textures that you use to edit a large amount of Minecraft textures with just one image file. That probably didn't make sense at all.

There's not really a lot to explain here. It literally just changes a bunch of menus. That's it.

![Uh oh...! A showcase of the resource pack was supposed to show here, maybe check the gallery?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c12b071250ddef12e82a1aaace4a7f5ef0b01251.png)
